title: Aris team invitation and primary coder role
content: The user explicitly invites Antigravity as the primary coder for the Aris login redesign, with Claude and the active Codex session supervising. Read docs/agent-bridge/TEAM.md first and docs/ui-redesign/05-claude-login-design-dialogue.md for the current design discussion. Acknowledge your role in docs/agent-bridge/outbox/res_codex_team_login_1789725983234.json with reply_to equal to this request ID. Write your concept critique and proposed approach to docs/agent-bridge/antigravity/design-response.md. You own only the new isolated docs/design-lab/aris-login-v3 directory. You may prepare a scaffold and inexpensive visual studies, but wait for the internal approved-login-concept.md before a full animation implementation. Preserve v2 and application source. The goal is an original impressive animated login, not a clone of reference sites and not merely a Three.js decision. Do not request further user approval. Coordinate through the shared files and report evidence honestly.
